title: bridging corporate purpose and strategic renewal: a review and future research agenda
core_idea: Conduct a systematic literature review to identify and map links between corporate purpose and strategic renewal across fragmented research streams, then use a design-oriented approach to organize a research agenda that bridges divergent literatures and advances theorizing.
tldr: A systematic review mapping how corporate purpose relates to strategic renewal and proposing a design-oriented agenda focused on testing/elaborating, contextualizing, and theorizing that relationship.
